title: Prime Minister Mark Carney talks major projects in northern visit

blocks.text: Prime Minister Mark Carney talks first visit to the Yukon

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is in Whitehorse this week to meet with government and First Nations officials. He's joining Yukon Morning host Elyn Jones in studio to talk about his visit, as well as the news out of the Supreme Court of Canada on Bill 21 in Quebec.

items: Late last night, Prime Minister Mark Carney announced he’s referring the Yukon Power Centres project to the Major Projects Office for official consideration to be fast-tracked.
Carney is set to fly to Yellowknife today, where he is expected to announce a major new initiative to "connect and transform Canada’s North."

In the North, other projects on the federal shortlist include: the Iqaluit Nukkiksautiit Hydro Project, the Grays Bay road and port in Nunavut, the Arctic economic and security corridor — an all-season road in the N.W.T. that would connect to Grays Bay — the Taltson Hydro Expansion project and the Mackenzie Valley Highway, which the federal government has already promised more than $3.1 billion to fund.
